title: Men's Gym – Twelve Labors. Zero Cardio. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Greek Gym Zip Up Hoodie – Twelve Labors. Zero Cardio.
seo.description: A greek gym zip up hoodie: TWELVE LABORS. ZERO CARDIO. on the back over a lion-headed hero on a treadmill, plus stitched ZERO CARDIO. lettering on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This greek gym zip up hoodie is for the lifter who will do twelve labors before he does one minute on the treadmill, zipped on for the warm-up and the walk to the squat rack.

A bearded lion-headed Greek hero in a pleated tunic and sandals strides stiffly on a treadmill drawn like a vase painting, in terracotta and black with a worn print texture. TWELVE LABORS. runs above it in two lines and ZERO CARDIO. below in collegiate slab capitals, the last line wider than the first: terracotta and cream on Black and Navy, brick red and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small ZERO over CARDIO. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the words LEG DAY? are stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest ZERO CARDIO. wordmark and left-cuff LEG DAY?, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Twelve Labors. Zero Cardio. zip hoodie fit?
The Twelve Labors. Zero Cardio. greek gym zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this greek gym hoodie warm enough for cold garage gyms?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold garage gyms, early warm-ups and the drive home well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, TWELVE LABORS. above the hero and ZERO CARDIO. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small ZERO over CARDIO. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and LEG DAY? is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The ZERO CARDIO. wordmark on the chest and the LEG DAY? cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a lifter, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the gym friend who skips the treadmill and never skips leg day. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
